title: Garmin vs Coros for Running: Which GPS Watch?
excerpt: Garmin vs Coros running watches compared on battery life, music, maps and price, using current models and manufacturer specs.
body:
Garmin vs Coros for Running: Which GPS Watch?

Updated November 2026. Prices are US list prices (MSRP) at the time of this update; retailers often sell for less.

The main differences between Garmin and Coros running watches are battery life, music, maps and price. At similar prices, Coros watches are rated for more hours of GPS. Garmin's music models can sync offline playlists from streaming services, which Coros watches can't. This comparison uses the current models and the manufacturers' own battery ratings.

Current models compared

All prices are US list prices (MSRP). Battery figures are each manufacturer's rating for a single activity. Real-world battery life is shorter with music, maps or an always-on display.

Garmin figures for the Forerunner 570 are for the 47 mm model. The Forerunner 170 and 170 Music are the same watch, apart from music storage.

Battery life

Battery is the clearest difference, and it shows at every price point.

  • Entry level: The Coros Pace 4 is rated for 41 hours of standard GPS at $249. The Garmin Forerunner 70 is rated for 23 hours at $249.99. The Garmin Forerunner 170 is rated for 20 hours at $299.99.
  • Mid-range: The Coros Pace 4 Pro is rated for 60 hours of GPS. The Garmin Forerunner 570 is rated for 18 hours in GPS-only mode.
  • Ultra distance: The Coros Vertix 2S is rated for 118 hours of standard GPS. Garmin's equivalent is the Enduro 3, rated for 120 hours of GPS, or up to 320 hours with enough sun on its solar lens.

For marathons and shorter races, every watch here has more than enough battery. The differences matter for 100K and 100-mile races, multi-day events, and for runners who don't want to charge more than once a week.

Music: streaming vs MP3 files

This is the other big difference.

  • Garmin music models (Forerunner 170 Music, 570 and 970) can download offline playlists from Spotify, Amazon Music and Deezer. You need a paid subscription that allows offline downloads. Garmin's manual says the watch must reconnect to the internet every 7 days to keep those downloads working. The Forerunner 170 Music has 4 GB of music storage.
  • The standard Forerunner 70 and 170 have no music storage.
  • Coros doesn't support streaming services. The Pace 4 plays MP3 files that you copy from a computer, using its 4 GB of storage. Some of that space is shared with maps and system data.
  • The Coros Pace 4 Pro has 32 GB of storage for MP3 files and maps.

If your music lives on Spotify, choose a Garmin music model. If you already own MP3 files, or listen on your phone, Coros costs less for the same battery life.

Maps and GPS accuracy

Both brands offer dual-band (multi-band) GPS from their mid-range models upward. This helps accuracy among tall buildings and under tree cover. According to TechRadar, the Garmin Forerunner 70 and 170 use multi-GNSS but not multi-band. The Coros Pace 4 includes dual-band GPS at $249.

For offline maps, the Garmin Forerunner 970 has full maps, but the Forerunner 570 offers only breadcrumb navigation. Coros added offline maps to the Pace 4, and the Pace 4 Pro has more storage for them.

Which should you buy?

  • Best battery for the money: Coros Pace 4.
  • Simplest first running watch: Garmin Forerunner 70 or 170.
  • Streaming music without your phone: Garmin Forerunner 170 Music, or the Forerunner 570 for multi-band GPS.
  • Maps and music in one watch: Garmin Forerunner 970, or the Coros Pace 4 Pro if MP3 files are enough.
  • 100-mile races and multi-day events: Coros Vertix 2S or Garmin Enduro 3.

FAQ

Which has better battery life, Garmin or Coros?

Coros, at comparable prices. For example, the Coros Pace 4 is rated for 41 hours of GPS. The Garmin Forerunner 70, at a similar price, is rated for 23 hours.

Can Coros watches play Spotify?

No. Coros watches play MP3 files you load yourself. For offline Spotify playlists on your wrist, you need a Garmin music model or another watch that supports it.

Is Garmin or Coros better for beginners?

Both work well. Garmin's Forerunner 70 and 170 are simple to use and work with Garmin's training app. The Coros Pace 4 costs about the same and lasts longer between charges.
